reviews.text: I have been using this app for YEARS, across multiple devices, often playing over a Bluetooth speaker. The recent updates did cause some minor issues, but I contacted them directly and not only were they receptive to my input, they used my feedback (I’m sure as well as others’) to fix these issues (some they are still looking into). Not only do I still love the app, but the devs have gained my respect personally.
